description: Türk ESL öğrenenlerin Tinder/Bumble opener'larında yapacağı yaygın hatalar. Bazıları phrase-bağımsız grammar kuralları, bazıları opener context-spesifik. Pattern matcher ve correction engine için.

mistakes.mistake: I have feeling that you are great storyteller.
mistakes.correction: I have A feeling that you are A great storyteller.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Sayılabilir tekil isimlerin önüne A/AN gerekiyor. Türkçe'de "bir" çoğu zaman atlanır, İngilizce'de zorunlu.

mistakes.mistake: I bored from this conversation already.
mistakes.correction: I'M bored OF this conversation already.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Türkçe "senden sıkıldım" → İngilizce'de "of" kullanılır, "from" değil. Ayrıca be-fiili (I'm) zorunlu.

mistakes.mistake: I going to ask you something.
mistakes.correction: I'M going to ask you something.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Şimdiki zaman (present continuous) için be-fiili (am/is/are) zorunlu. Türkçe'de bu eki yok.

mistakes.mistake: How is going your day?
mistakes.correction: How is your day going?
mistakes.tr_explanation: İngilizce'de soru cümlesinde özne-fiil sıralaması: "How + is + [özne] + going?". Türkçe sıralaması farklı.

mistakes.mistake: I want match you for long time.
mistakes.correction: I've wanted to match WITH you FOR A long time.
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) "want" sonrası "to + fiil" gerekiyor. 2) "match" fiil olarak "with" alır. 3) "long time" önünde "a" zorunlu. 4) Geçmişten süregelen istek için present perfect.

mistakes.mistake: Your bio said you love hiking.
mistakes.correction: Your bio SAYS you love hiking.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Yazılı bir şeyi şu an okuyorsan "says" (geniş zaman). Bio şu an oradadır, yazılmıştır ama şu an var.

mistakes.mistake: I'm here since 2 years.
mistakes.correction: I've been here FOR 2 years.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Bir süredir devam eden durum için present perfect + "for" (süre). "Since" başlangıç noktası için.

mistakes.mistake: Are you a planner or you wing it?
mistakes.correction: Are you a planner, or DO YOU wing it?
mistakes.tr_explanation: İkinci soruda da "do you" yapısı tekrarlanmalı. Türkçe'de tek bir "misin" yeterli ama İngilizce'de iki ayrı soru.

mistakes.mistake: I have one informations to share.
mistakes.correction: I have one PIECE OF information to share.
mistakes.tr_explanation: "Information" sayılamayan isim (uncountable). "Pieces of information" deyimi kullanılır. Çoğul "informations" yanlış.

mistakes.mistake: I make a photo of myself last week.
mistakes.correction: I TOOK a photo of myself last week.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Türkçe "fotoğraf çekmek" idiomu İngilizce'de "TAKE a photo". "Make" değil. Geçmiş zaman da "took".

mistakes.mistake: I going say something funny.
mistakes.correction: I'M going TO say something funny.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Gelecek için "going to + fiil" yapısı: am/is/are + going to + base verb. "To" zorunlu.

mistakes.mistake: I'm afraid from saying wrong thing.
mistakes.correction: I'm afraid OF saying THE wrong thing.
mistakes.tr_explanation: "Afraid of" sabit phrase. Türkçe "X'den korkmak" → İngilizce'de "of". Ayrıca "the wrong thing" — belirli.

mistakes.mistake: Always I overthink openers.
mistakes.correction: I always overthink openers.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Sıklık zarfları (always, never, often) özneden sonra, fiilden önce gelir. Türkçe başta serbest, İngilizce sabit pozisyon.

mistakes.mistake: Do you can come Saturday?
mistakes.correction: Can you come Saturday?
mistakes.tr_explanation: Modal fiiller (can, will, should) kendi soruyu kurar — "do" yardımcısına gerek yok. "Can you" direkt.

mistakes.mistake: It's a unique idea.
mistakes.correction: It's A unique idea.
mistakes.tr_explanation: "Unique" /jü-/ sesiyle başlar (konsonant gibi). Bu yüzden "a" kullanılır, "an" değil. Yazılı u harfine bakma, sese bak.

mistakes.mistake: Best or worst pickup line you have got?
mistakes.correction: Best or worst pickup line you'VE EVER GOTTEN?
mistakes.tr_explanation: Tüm hayatın boyu olan deneyim için present perfect + "ever". "Got" yerine "gotten" (US English doğal).

mistakes.mistake: I have feeling you are great storyteller.
mistakes.correction: I have A feeling you are A great storyteller.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Sayılabilir tekil isimlerden önce A/AN. "A feeling" ve "a great storyteller".

mistakes.mistake: Plot twist — I am bad in openers.
mistakes.correction: Plot twist — I am bad AT openers.
mistakes.tr_explanation: "Bad at" / "good at" sabit preposition. "In" değil. Bir konuda yeteneği belirten ifade.

mistakes.mistake: We can meet at middle.
mistakes.correction: We could meet IN THE middle.
mistakes.tr_explanation: "In the middle" sabit ifade. "At middle" değil. Ayrıca "could" daha nazik (hypothetical).

mistakes.mistake: I read your profile twice but I didn't.
mistakes.correction: I read your profile twice — and I didn't (come up with one).
mistakes.tr_explanation: "I did not" tek başına "yapamadım" anlamı veriyor; "but" yerine "and" veya dash ile daha akıcı.

mistakes.mistake: I am try to think clever thing.
mistakes.correction: I'M tryING to think OF SOMETHING clever.
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) Be-fiil + -ing (try → trying). 2) "Think of" sabit. 3) "Something clever" — adjective sonra.

mistakes.mistake: Photo with the dog made me to smile.
mistakes.correction: THE photo with the dog made me smile.
mistakes.tr_explanation: "Make + someone + base verb" — to-infinitive yok. "Make me smile" (gülmemi sağladı). Ayrıca belirli fotoğraf için "the".

mistakes.mistake: There is a 60% chance we get along.
mistakes.correction: There's a 60% chance we'D get along.
mistakes.tr_explanation: Olasılık için conditional: "we would (we'd) get along". Şu an gerçekleşmediği için "would" — Türkçe "anlaşırdık".

mistakes.mistake: I match you 3 days before.
mistakes.correction: I matched WITH you 3 days AGO.
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) Past tense: matched. 2) "Match with" preposition. 3) Geçmişe referans "ago", "before" değil.

mistakes.mistake: I am here for figure out if you like same dumb things.
mistakes.correction: I'm here TO figure out if you'RE INTO the same dumb things.
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) Amaç için "to + base verb" (for değil). 2) "You are" → contraction. 3) "Be into X" = X'e ilgi duymak (idiom).

mistakes.mistake: Your photos look like you are interesting more than me.
mistakes.correction: Your photos look like you'D be MORE interesting than I am.
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) Karşılaştırma: more interesting than. 2) Hypothetical: would (gerçek değil, tahmin). 3) Format: "more X than Y".

mistakes.mistake: Coffee or cocktail which one you make me to choose wrong?
mistakes.correction: Coffee or cocktails — which one ARE you GOING TO make me CHOOSE wrong?
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) Çoğul "cocktails" doğal. 2) Soruda "are you going to" yardımcı yapı. 3) "Make + me + base verb" — to yok.

mistakes.mistake: If I ask you for coffee, would you say yes?
mistakes.correction: If I ASKED you OUT for coffee, would you say yes?
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) Hypothetical second conditional: "if + past, would". 2) "Ask someone out" idiom = romantik olarak teklif et.

mistakes.mistake: Are you here for chat or collect matches?
mistakes.correction: Are you here for THE chat, or (just) TO collect matches?
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) "For" sonrası noun ("the chat"), "to" sonrası verb ("to collect"). Karışık yapı.

mistakes.mistake: i am turkish from istanbul.
mistakes.correction: I'm Turkish, from Istanbul.
mistakes.tr_explanation: 1) İlk harf "I" her zaman büyük. 2) Milliyet/şehir adları büyük harfle (Turkish, Istanbul). 3) Virgül.
